Name: Better Lightning Rods
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod makes lightning rods more (or less) useful, by tweaking the following config variables:

[list]
[*] "UniqueCheck": true, - don't check the same rod twice per strike
[*]"OnlyCheckEmpty": false - if true, the game will only attempt to charge empty rods

[*]"RodsToCheck": 2, - how many rods to check each strike

[*]"LightningChance": 13 - base percent chance for lightning to strike every ten minutes

[/list]
Normally, lightning has a 12.5% base chance to strike every ten minutes (modified by player luck). If lightning strikes, the game normally checks a random rod twice (could be the same rod) to see if it can be charged).

You can edit all the config variables using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or editing the [b]config.json[/b] file.

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].
